Market today: Treasury yields are up, which usually puts pressure on growth/tech names. The real driver is likely the macro environment, not specific company news.

Your holdings: SOXL (-32.1%) and SPAL (-33.96%) are the big red flags needing attention. They are leveraged ETFs and margin amplifies their drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on the tech/chip sector sentiment as yields move.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and protecting your capital.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged position given the significant loss and decay risk.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate reducing exposure due to the large drawdown and leveraged nature.
METU: This leveraged ETF is up 53.09%. Consider taking some profit or adjusting stop loss higher.
